_meta.change_protocol: CLO sign-off required for any change. Vishal raises Jira tickets to Ajay for additions; never edits unilaterally.

designation: BEFORE THE NATIONAL CONSUMER DISPUTES REDRESSAL COMMISSION, NEW DELHI
jurisdictionNote: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission constituted under Section 53 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. Pecuniary jurisdiction: value of goods/services paid as consideration exceeding Rs. 10 Crore. Also hears appeals from State Commissions. Located in New Delhi.

party_designation.state: Union of India through the Secretary, Department of Consumer Affairs

prayer_language.opening: In view of the facts and circumstances stated hereinabove, it is most respectfully prayed that this Honourable Commission may be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: Any other relief which this Honourable Commission deems fit and proper may also be granted in favour of the Complainant.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, the Complainant herein above named, do hereby verify that the contents of the above complaint are true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief, and nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

COMPLAINANT

formattingPreferences.causeListFormat: BEFORE THE NATIONAL CONSUMER DISPUTES REDRESSAL COMMISSION, {city}

localRules: Consumer complaint must be accompanied by an affidavit in support (Section 35(2) CPA 2019).
Original or certified copies of all documents relied upon must be filed.
Pecuniary jurisdiction: NCDRC hears complaints where value exceeds Rs. 10 Crore.
Complaint must be filed within 2 years from the date of cause of action (Section 69 CPA 2019).
Filing fees as per NCDRC Fee Rules.
Appeals from State Commissions must be filed within 30 days of the impugned order.
